{{Short description|American entomology professor}}
'''Peter F. Bellinger''' (1924–2017) was an American [[entomology]] professor who specialized in [[Collembola]].<ref name="Culver2017-1">{{Cite journal |last=Culver |first=David C. |date=2017-12-22 |title=Kenneth A. Christiansen (1924–2017) |url=https://subtbiol.pensoft.net/article/22905/ |journal=Subterranean Biology |language=en |publisher=Pensoft Publishers |volume=24 |pages=53–61 |doi=10.3897/subtbiol.24.22905 |doi-access=free |bibcode=2017SubBi..24...53C |issn=1314-2615}}</ref><ref name="www.collembola.org-1">{{Cite web |title=Checklist of the Collembola of the World |url=https://www.collembola.org/ |access-date=2026-11-12 |website=www.collembola.org}}</ref><ref name="collembole.free.fr-1">{{Cite web |title=Checklist of the Collembola: Collembola species catalogue |url=http://collembole.free.fr/collembola/publicat/bellingr/indexx.htm |access-date=2026-11-12 |website=collembole.free.fr}}</ref>

== Career ==
Bellinger was a forward observer in [[World War II]] with the [[United States Army]], where he ranked corporal. After the war he went to [[Harvard University]]. He then transferred to Harvard, eventually obtaining a Harvard PHD in Collembology.<ref name="Culver2017-1" /><ref name="collembole.free.fr-1" />

== Literature ==
Bellinger described many species of [[springtail]]s alongside [[University of California]] professor Peter F. Bellinger. This eventually accumulated to their final publication of C&B in 1998.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://grinnell.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/delivery/01GCL_INST:GCL/12313110720004641 |title=The Collembola of North America, North of the Rio Grande: A Taxonomic Analysis - 4 Volumes |access-date=2026-11-12 |website=grinnell.primo.exlibrisgroup.com |language=en}}</ref> He was also noted for helping review [[Frans Janssens (taxonomist)|Frans Janssen]]'s website Collembolla.org.<ref name="www.collembola.org-1" />

== Species described ==
Some species described by Bellinger are listed below:

*''[[Ptenothrix delongi]]'' (Christiansen & Bellinger, 1981) 
*''[[Ptenothrix californica]]'' (Christiansen & Bellinger, 1981) 
*''[[Ptenothrix beta]]'' (Christiansen & Bellinger, 1981)
